issues.legal_issue: A devisee is not entitled to immediate possession of property when the will places that property within an estate managed by executors for the payment of legacies and postpones possession until their administration ends.
material_facts: The will placed the testator’s whole estate, including the disputed house, under the executors’ management.
The executors were directed to use estate income to pay legacies during the administration period.
The will gave the devisee the house on the expiry of the executors’ term of office.
The executors had been replaced by an administrator, who sought a determination of the right to possess the house during the administration period.
issues.conclusion: The administrator was entitled to possession of the house during the administration period, and the devisee’s right to possession arose only when that period ended; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: A legatee ordinarily takes property on the terms of the will. Under Sections 119 and 138 of the Succession Act, a direction postponing possession may be ineffective where an absolute interest is bequeathed, but Section 138 applies only where the bequest is absolute; postponement is not repugnant where the interim interest is applied for another’s benefit. The Court applied the principles in Saunders v. Vautier (1841) 4 Beav 115 and Gosling v. Gosling (1859) Johns 265, and treated Profulla Chander v. Jogendra Nath, 1 Cal LJ 605, as analogous.

rule.if: appeal_on_will_construction and will_places_entire_estate_under_executor_management and disputed_property_in_managed_estate and estate_income_directed_to_pay_legacies and possession_granted_after_executor_administration

predicates.appeal_on_will_construction: A party appealed from a decision determining rights to property under the construction of a will.
predicates.will_places_entire_estate_under_executor: The will directs executors to manage the whole estate during an administration period.
predicates.disputed_property_in_managed_estate: The property whose possession is disputed forms part of the estate managed by the executors.
predicates.estate_income_directed_to_pay_legacies: The will directs the executors to use estate income to pay legacies during administration.
predicates.possession_granted_after_executor_admini: The will grants the devisee possession of the disputed property after the executors’ administration ends.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerning a will involves property included in an estate managed by executors, estate income used for legacies, and possession granted only after administration, the executors are entitled to possession during administration.
